data.summary_en: CacheFit couples ChampSim, HARCOM, and LLM proposing policy variants; circuit-level costs enter search objective, scoring LLC replacement policies by latency, area, power, and speedup during algorithm writing. MPPPB-generated Fit-MPPPB: -60.3% storage, -56.3% static power, -58.9% transistors, +1.1% IPC, +7.5 pp SPEC CPU2017 hit rate.
